## What the original guide said

::: {.callout-note title="Archived explanation · not independently verified reporting"}
Allows temporary replacements on the Commission on Judicial Disabilities when members are recused, disqualified, or finish their terms without replacements. Substitutes must meet constitutional eligibility requirements.

**Original recommendation: YES.** This records Everett’s pre-election position, not the election result. The archive retains the full reasoning.
:::

[Read the ballot guide](../guide/index.qmd#question-2).
